map.固有频率低代表什么？: What Does a Low Natural Frequency Mean?
map.质量大或刚度小则固有频率低，越容易隔离高频扰动（隔振比更高）。: A large mass or small stiffness lowers the natural frequency, which makes high-frequency disturbance easier to isolate (a higher isolation ratio).
map.和音频声学有什么关系？: What Does It Have to Do with Audio Acoustics?
map.结构振动会辐射声波，固有频率决定结构噪声的主要频段，是声学设计的耦合点。: Structural vibration radiates sound waves, and the natural frequency sets the main frequency band of structural noise — a key coupling point in acoustic design.
